name: Heaven of Blood War
body:
Also known as the Path of the Blood Armory, this path is all about the manipulation and shaping of the bloodlord’s own blood to become their arms and armor, to improve their physique, or evolve to exceed the constraints of mortal limits, according to their needs as necessary.

Base Attack Bonus: Equal to their class level.

Class Skills

The class skills for the Bloodlord are Acrobatics (Dex), Climb (Str), Escape Artist (Dex), Handle Animal (Cha), Intimidate (Cha), Ride (Dex), Sense Motive (Wis), Survival (Wis), and Swim (Str).

Weapon and Armor Proficiency

This path grants proficiency in all light and medium armor, light shields, bucklers, all simple weapons, and all light and onehanded martial weapons.

Bonus Blood Talent: At 1st level, a bloodlord who chooses the heaven of blood war as their specialization gains either blood bulwark or blood weaponry as a bonus blood talent in addition to their first blood talent.

Heaven of Blood War Bloodline Limits

A bloodlord can select a bonus feat (with any of the following tags shown below) or any one of the following options (from any of the classes shown below for each option): a bonus rage power or talent.

Feats: Called Shot, Combat, Combination, Critical, Performance, Shield Mastery, Style, Targeting, And Weapon Mastery.
Rage Power: available for use only during an active blood burn which counts as the rage class feature for the purposes of using the chosen rage power; barbarian (core, unchained, Legendary), bloodrager (core, Legendary), and skald (core, Legendary).
Talents: ranger (core, Legendary), slayer (core, Legendary), and vigilante (from the avenger specialization only). If a chosen bonus feat, rage power, or talent has a resource cost or additional benefits that use the stamina and combat tricks rules from Pathfinder Unchained, the bloodlord can spend sanguine points from their blood bank as a free action to gain stamina points that can be immediately used to activate the combat trick of the chosen bonus feat. The bloodlord can obtain 1 stamina point, round of rage, or other resource pool for every 4 sanguine points spent in this way. If the chosen bonus feat has a BAB requirement of +11 or higher, or a specific class level of 10 or higher, the bloodlord can only obtain 1 stamina point for every 8 sanguine points spent in this way on the combat trick – this represents the increased difficulty in mimicking the true martial champions.

The bloodlord cannot spend the stamina point gained this way on anything else but the combat trick of the chosen bonus feat and any unspent stamina point is lost at the start of the bloodlord’s next turn. This does not grant the bloodlord a stamina pool, thus they cannot benefit from any combat trick or effect that requires a stamina pool unless they already possess a stamina pool via another source, such as a class. The bloodlord must follow all other rules about stamina and combat tricks.

The bloodlord cannot recover any stamina points unless they already possess the means to do so via another source , such as a class.

The bloodlord can obtain 1 resource point for every 4 sanguine points they spend in this way.

The bloodlord cannot spend the resource point gained this way on anything else but to gain the listed benefits through expending the resource point(s) cost of the chosen bonus rage power/talent and any unspent resource point is lost at the start of the bloodlord’s next turn.

If the bonus rage power/talent has a BAB requirement of +11 or higher or a specific class level of 10 or higher, the bloodlord can only obtain 1 resource point for every 8 stamina points in this way – this represents the increased difficulty in mimicking the true martial champions.

This does not grant the bloodlord a resource pool, thus they cannot benefit from any chosen bonus rage power/talent or effect that requires a resource pool unless they already possess the relevant resource pool via another source, such as a class. The bloodlord cannot recover any resource point for the chosen bonus rage power/talent unless they already possess the means to do so via another source, such as a class.

Once the choice is made, the bloodlord cannot freely change the choice, but they can retrain the choice as per the retraining rules for the chosen bonus feat/rage power/talent, if appropriate.
